label: The mux-D scan cell
subgoals: Place a multiplexer before each flip-flop controlled by scan enable
Connect each flop's output to the next flop's scan input
Shift with scan enable at 1 and capture with scan enable at 0

label: A scan test cycle
subgoals: Shift the stimulus in for as many cycles as the longest chain
Capture the response with one functional clock
Shift the response out while the next stimulus shifts in

label: Test time
subgoals: Multiply patterns by chain length plus one
Add one final unload of chain length
Divide the cycles by the shift frequency for test time
